summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly buyback transactions under its ongoing share repurchase programme originally announced on 4 February 2026. From 16-22 July 2026 the bank repurchased 13 million own shares at weighted average prices ranging from €11.7786 to €12.1261 per share across the XMAD and CEUX trading venues. Cumulative cash spent through 22 July was €4,053 million or ~80.6% of the programme’s maximum investment cap, representing roughly 17.5% of outstanding shares since 2021. The buyback is being executed in compliance with EU Market Abuse Regulation. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. What to watch: pace of remaining purchases and potential impact on EPS.
